formalism.claim: State space: rays in complex Hilbert space; observables: self-adjoint operators; composition: tensor product; dynamics: unitary evolution

primitives.claim: Hilbert-space structure and tensor-product composition are primitives, not derived
primitives.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 Q17 minimum input set includes 'quantum structure'

primitives.claim: The Born postulate is a primitive of the standard formulation
primitives.source: archive: 'QM ──ENCODES──▶ measurement statistics [T] CLOSED (Born as postulate)'
primitives.caveat: derivation programs exist and were audited: EC_BORN_01 Phase 2A found no route free of imported premises (abstract-level evidence only, hostile audit not executed)

primitives.claim: The local tensor factorization (which subsystems) is not intrinsic to the Hilbert space; spectrum-only recovery is uniqueness-given-existence, genericity-qualified
primitives.source: Cotler, Penington & Ranard, Commun. Math. Phys. 368, 1267 (2019), arXiv:1702.06142 — abstract verified 2026-09-23
primitives.caveat: existence of a k-local factorization is the conditional half

derived_objects.claim: Decoherence (suppression of interference in reduced states) is derived within closed unitary QM plus coarse-graining
derived_objects.source: archive: Experiment P repaired model, REALITY_CHECK_04 §10 ('produce reduced-state decoherence while preserving a pure global entangled state'); consistent with community decoherence theory (RC-05 C2)
derived_objects.caveat: tested model class: minimal closed s2⊗a2⊗eN with exact unitaries

derived_objects.claim: The uncertainty principle is equivalent to an entropy bound on pure states (one-directional: the bound is stronger)
derived_objects.source: Carcassi & Aidala, Found. Phys. 52:40 (2022), arXiv:2111.09107 — full-text case extraction 2026-09-23
derived_objects.caveat: one degree of freedom in the source
